props.gloss_en: R' Romanus: Rabbi permitted me to move a fire-pan with its ashes
the mishna: a person may take up his son with a stone in his hand, or a basket with a stone in it
R' Yochanan: [the mishna] deals with a basket full of fruit
R' Asi: here too [the fire-pan] has bits [of incense] in it
the baraita: poor men's [scraps] count for the poor, rich men's for the rich, but poor men's do not count for the rich
Abaye: [the fire-pan] is just like a chamber pot of excrement
Rava: at Rav Nachman's house we used to move a brazier on account of its ashes, even with broken bits of wood on it
the baraita: and they agree that if [the lamp] has fragments of wick in it, it may not be moved

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה רבי זירא לרבי אסי: מי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והתנן: a basket with a stone in it -- and R' Yochanan set it in a basket full of fruit: the reason is the fruit; without fruit, no. And the fire-pan's ashes are not fruit

objections.gloss_en: אמר אביי: קרטין בי רבי מי חשיבי? וכי תימא חזו לעניים -- והתניא: בגדי עניים לעניים... אבל דעניים לעשירים לא (47a.4). Unanswered: אלא אמר אביי
